water_reeds.name: Reeds

water_lily.name: Lily pads
water_lily.description: Pale flowers float on the water.

manor_gate.name: Iron gate
manor_gate.description: Heavy wrought iron; the estate lies beyond.

gate_garden_south.name: Garden gate
gate_garden_south.description: A closed wrought-iron gate. It does not open from this side.

gate_courtyard_south.name: Courtyard gate
gate_courtyard_south.description: A closed wrought-iron gate leading out of the estate.

manor_building.name: Manor house
manor_building.description: The great house looms against the sky.

stable_building.name: Stable
stable_building.description: The west end of the timber stables. The rest continues beyond the courtyard wall.

ash_canister.name: Ash canister
ash_canister.description: A blackened tin canister for hearth ash. Charred scraps of paper cling to the rim.

crummy_bed.name: Crummy bed
crummy_bed.description: A narrow iron bed with a thin mattress and a threadbare blanket.

guest_bed.name: Guest bed
guest_bed.description: A comfortable oak bed with fresh linen and a folded counterpane.

vanity_table.name: Vanity table
vanity_table.description: A modest dressing table with a looking-glass and a few guest toiletries.

manor_vanity.name: Dressing table
manor_vanity.description: An ornate vanity with a gilt-framed mirror and silver-backed brushes.

old_shelf.name: Old shelf
old_shelf.description: A battered wooden shelf, half empty and thick with dust.

writing_table.name: Writing table
writing_table.description: A small desk scarred by ink stains, with a ledger and quill.

reading_table.name: Reading table
reading_table.description: A broad oak table strewn with open volumes and a green banker's lamp.

manor_lord_bed.name: Lord's bed
manor_lord_bed.description: A vast carved four-poster bed with damask hangings — von Virtanen's own.

kitchen_table.name: Kitchen table
kitchen_table.description: A sturdy work surface, flour-dusted at the edges.

booze_table.name: Side table
booze_table.description: Empty glasses and a crystal decanter.

drinking_chair.name: Armchair
drinking_chair.description: Leather worn smooth where many have sat.

fancy_chair.name: Gilded chair
fancy_chair.description: Velvet upholstery and gilt carving — meant for watching, not dancing.

dining_table.name: Dining table
dining_table.description: A long table set for many guests.

staircase.name: Staircase
staircase.description: Stone steps leading to another floor.

cellar_hatch.name: Cellar hatch
cellar_hatch.description: A rough rocky pit in the ground — a ladder leads down into the cellars.
cellar_hatch.confirmPrompt: A wooden ladder drops into the darkness below. Descend into the cellars?

manor_carpet.name: Persian rug
manor_carpet.description: An enormous hand-knotted carpet sprawls across the lord's chamber.

bathtub.name: Bathtub
bathtub.description: A claw-foot tub, dry and dusty.

toilet.name: Toilet
toilet.description: Porcelain fixture; the chain hangs loose.

water_boiler.name: Water boiler
water_boiler.description: A copper cylinder; cold to the touch.

secret_bookshelf.name: Bookshelves
secret_bookshelf.description: One book juts out slightly from the middle shelf.
secret_bookshelf.confirmPrompt: One volume sits loose on the shelf, almost asking to be pulled. Will you tug it free?
secret_bookshelf.blockedConfirmHint: The shelves look ordinary. Perhaps the attic floor plans will show the way.

study_passage_switch.name: Hidden lever
study_passage_switch.description: A cord hangs down from the rock face to a rusted lever.
study_passage_switch.confirmPrompt: A cord hangs down to a hidden lever. Pull it to open the passage to the study?
study_passage_switch.blockedConfirmHint: You would not know which lever to pull without the manor floor plans.

secret_cellar_barrels.name: Stacked barrels
secret_cellar_barrels.description: Heavy casks are wedged across the passage.
secret_cellar_barrels.confirmPrompt: A rusted lever is tucked between the casks. Pull it to roll the barrels aside?
secret_cellar_barrels.blockedConfirmHint: The barrels look undisturbed. Search the storage room first.

cellar_passage_switch.name: Hidden lever
cellar_passage_switch.description: A rusted lever is set into the tunnel wall.
cellar_passage_switch.confirmPrompt: A rusted lever is set into the rock. Pull it to open the way to the cellar?
cellar_passage_switch.blockedConfirmHint: You would not know which lever to pull without the manor floor plans.

stable_booth.name: Stall
stable_booth.description: A chestnut horse shifts restlessly in the straw.

stable_booth_bay.name: Stall
stable_booth_bay.description: A bay horse stamps its hoof against the straw.

stable_booth_gray.name: Stall
stable_booth_gray.description: A dappled grey dozes with one ear turned toward the door.

wine_barrel.name: Wine barrel
wine_barrel.description: An oak cask, still heavy with age.

wine_rack.name: Wine rack
wine_rack.description: Dusty bottles lie in stone niches.

oil_lamp.name: Oil lamp
oil_lamp.description: Warm light wavers inside the soot-stained chimney.

spider_web.name: Cobwebs
spider_web.description: Cobwebs thicken in the stale air.

spider_web_br.name: Cobwebs
spider_web_br.description: Cobwebs thicken in the stale air.

attic_roof_bar.name: Roof cross-beam
attic_roof_bar.description: A heavy timber spans the attic beneath the ridge.

attic_roof_beam_h.name: Roof timber
attic_roof_beam_h.description: A heavy beam runs beneath the ridge.

attic_roof_beam_v.name: Hanging brace
attic_roof_beam_v.description: A short timber brace hangs from the roof frame.

attic_ceiling_post.name: Roof brace
attic_ceiling_post.description: A timber brace drops from the rafters to the cross-beam.

attic_floor_post.name: Support post
attic_floor_post.description: A stout post anchors the roof truss to the floorboards.

stuffed_moose.name: Stuffed moose
stuffed_moose.description: A glass-eyed bull moose looms over the room, antlers spread wide above a mahogany plaque.

armor_stand.name: Suit of armor
armor_stand.description: A polished harness of plate mail stands at attention, halberd at its side.

hall_clock.name: Grand hall clock
hall_clock.description: A tall case clock frozen at eleven. The glazed door is shattered — splinters still litter the floor below.

clock_glass_shards.name: Broken glass
clock_glass_shards.description: Shards of the clock's door lie scattered across the boards.

baron_blood_pool.name: Blood pool
baron_blood_pool.description: Blood has pooled beneath the body.

locked_cabinet.name: Locked cabinet
locked_cabinet.description: A heavy iron cabinet bolted to the stone wall.
locked_cabinet.confirmPrompt: The silver key fits the lock. Open the cabinet?
locked_cabinet.blockedConfirmHint: The cabinet is locked. The journal said von Virtanen had been walking in the garden afterward — he seems to have lost the key there.

blood_crate.name: Stained crate
blood_crate.description: An ordinary wooden crate. Nothing more to examine.

grand_piano.name: Grand piano
grand_piano.description: Ebony keys yellow with age. A sour chord clatters when you touch them.

bedside_table.name: Bedside table
bedside_table.description: A small mahogany table beside the lord's bed.

rusty_old_key.name: Rusty old key
rusty_old_key.description: A tarnished iron key, heavy in the hand.

barons_diary.name: von Virtanen's diary
barons_diary.description: A leather-bound diary with von Virtanen's crest on the cover.

attic_old_chest.name: Old chest
attic_old_chest.description: A battered oak chest bound with iron straps.
attic_old_chest.confirmPrompt: The chest is locked. Use the rusty old key?
attic_old_chest.blockedConfirmHint: The chest is locked. Von Virtanen's diary said the groundskeeper keeps the attic key.
